journey.name: Plan a session on Lift
journey.description: Plan any session on Lift for today from the first run, start it from Log's Coming up, log a set and finish, then find today's plan done. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "+" on today's weekday row in "Routine"
In the "Add to plan" sheet, tap "Lift"
Verify that the sheet says "No program followed" and "Any lift session" is picked
Verify that today's row shows an "Any lift session" chip with a kettlebell beside it
Verify that "Coming up" shows "Today" with "Lift session" with "Start"
Tap today on the week strip
Verify that the day sheet shows "Any lift session" reading "Done · Every" and today's weekday
